'''Trax Sector Command''' was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. It was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entrus]] and was commanded by [[Beckar]].
